evidence.description: Boot-time trigger documented in docs/analysis_traceability.md (2025-11-05 session): 'Boot-time helper maybe_update_from_udisk (0x0026887c) invokes update_copy_or_flash twice (BOOT then APP) after boot_holdkey_update_check arms the pipeline.'
Entry point called by bootloader after hold-key detection. Initiates USB scanning pipeline.
First filename matching loop. Calls memcmp @ 0x0020E158, branches to 0x002C28D0 on success or 0x002C47F0 on failure.
Upgrade mechanism fully documented in docs/update_file_rules.md with objdump evidence, memcmp call sites, and handler linkages. No checksums found in upgrade pipeline.

raw_note:
VERIFIED VIA DOCUMENTATION AND USER TESTING (2025-11-27/28)

=== USB ARCHITECTURE (CORRECTED) ===

Device has USB DEVICE mode (MSC), NOT USB host:
• "USB" menu activates USB Mass Storage Class mode
• Exposes 64MB "MINI" volume to PC (FAT16)
• PC sees: nuvoTon USB MSC (VID:0416 PID:0093)
• Model: W55FA93 SPI Disk
• Device CANNOT accept external USB sticks
• No USB host capability confirmed

=== VOLUME ARCHITECTURE ===

SD Card: 4GB total, NO classic MBR
Starts with raw firmware binaries at offset 0
Signature @ 0x200: 0xa5 5a 42 57 ... 57 42 5a a5

Volume 0:/ "MINI" (64MB FAT16):
• Exposed via USB MSC when "USB" menu active
• User staging area for file transfers
• "File → USB" menu browses this volume
• testdisk: FAT filesystem #1

Volume 3:/ "Internal" (~3.8GB FAT):
• NOT exposed via USB MSC
• System working storage
• Fonts, resources, processed files
• About screen: "SD: OK | 0.8/3.8GB"
• 0.8GB used, ~3.0GB FREE
• testdisk: FAT filesystem #2

=== FIRMWARE UPDATE TRIGGERS ===

METHOD 1: Boot-Time Hold-Key
────────────────────────────────
bootloader: boot_holdkey_update_check
  ↓
VA 0x0026887C: maybe_update_from_udisk
  ↓
VA 0x0026CCF8: update_copy_or_flash
  ↓
Three parallel loops scan volume 3:/
  • VA 0x0025A930 - Firmware (BOOT/APP)
  • VA 0x0025A990 - UI assets
  • VA 0x0025A9F0 - QVGA UI
  ↓
VA 0x0020E158: memcmp (filename match)
  ↓
Success: VA 0x002C28D0 (upgrade-found)
Failure: VA 0x002C47F0 (no upgrade found)

METHOD 2: Runtime Menu (User Discovery)
────────────────────────────────────────
Workflow:
1. Connect printer to PC via USB cable
2. Navigate "USB" menu on printer
3. Wait for "Device is connected" message
4. PC mounts MINI volume (64MB staging)
5. Copy upgrade files to MINI:
   - ZK-INKJET-NANO-BOOT.bin
   - ZK-INKJET-NANO-APP.bin  
   - ZK-INKJET-UI-QVGA.bin
6. Disconnect from PC
7. Navigate "OS Update" or "UI Update" menu
8. System COPIES: MINI (0:/) → Internal (3:/)
9. System processes from volume 3:/
10. Result messages:
    "No upgrade file found please try again!" [OK]
      Handler: VA 0x002C47F0
    OR upgrade proceeds via VA 0x002C28D0

=== BMP PRINTING TRIGGER (DISCOVERED) ===

File Browser Method:
────────────────────
Workflow:
1. Connect printer to PC via USB cable
2. Navigate "USB" menu → "Device is connected"
3. PC mounts MINI volume
4. Copy BMP files to MINI
   - ANY filename works (not just inkjet-ui-*.bmp)
5. Disconnect from PC
6. Navigate: Start → "File" → "USB"
7. File browser shows MINI volume contents
8. Select BMP file → "Open"
9. Image editor loads with controls:
   - zoom+, zoom-, turn, mirror
10. Press "Start" → [Printing screen] → Print!

File Browser Features:
• Open - Load BMP into editor
• Delete - Remove files from MINI
• Find - Search for files  
• New - Create folders
• Rename - Rename files
• Save/Save as - Save edited images

BMP Pattern String:
• Location: VA 0x0001282C
• Pattern: "3:/inkjet-ui-%04d%02d%02d %02d%02d%02d %d.bmp"
• Format: inkjet-ui-YYYYMMDD HHMMSS N.bmp
• Purpose: Auto-generated when using "Save as"
• NOT required for manual file browsing

=== COMPLETE MENU STRUCTURE ===

Start Screen:
├─ "File" → "Local" | "USB" → [File/Folder Browser]
│           ├─ Open, Delete, Find, New (folder)
│           ├─ Rename, Save, Save as  
│           └─ [Select file] → Image editor
├─ "Add" → [Items not fully explored]
├─ "Edit"
├─ "Delete"
├─ "Start" → [Printing screen]
├─ "Settings" → Submenus below
└─ Arrow keys: <, >, zoom+, zoom-, turn, mirror

Settings Submenus:
├─ "About" → Diagnostic screen
│   Shows: RAM voltage, SD status, USB status,
│          GPIO-4xPIN, ENC:NO, timestamps
├─ "Nozzle" → TB Rev | Nozzle Voltage |
│              Pulse Width | Print Darkness |
│              DPI | Cartridge Type |
│              Nozzle Select | Sync Width
├─ "USB" → "Device is connected" /
│          "Waiting for connection"
│          (Activates USB MSC mode)
├─ "OS Update" → {Tips} "Nano Boot"
│   → Scans MINI for BOOT/APP.bin
│   → "No upgrade file found please try again!" [OK]
├─ "UI Update" → {Tips} "UI Update"  
│   → Scans MINI for UI-QVGA.bin
│   → "No upgrade file found please try again!" [OK]
├─ "Touch" → Touch calibration
├─ "Date & Time" → System time settings
├─ "Language" → Localization (Dutch/German/etc)
├─ "Print" → Touch-tone | Print tone |
│            Sync Mode | Start Signal |
│            Print Times | Idle Spray Time
└─ "Reset" → "This action will delete all user data!"
             [OK] [Cancel]

=== LITERAL POOL & HANDLERS ===

Literal Pool: VA 0x0037E820
• 3:/ZK-INKJET-NANO-BOOT.bin
• 3:/ZK-INKJET-NANO-APP.bin
• 3:/ZK-INKJET-UI-QVGA.bin  
• 3:/ZK-INKJET-UI.bin
• Legacy names for backward compatibility

Pool Iterator: VA 0x00217DD0
• Iterates literal pool
• Pushes candidates to worker routines
• Called indirectly by memcmp loops

Message Dispatch Table: VA 0x003D3E00
• 287 entries × 12 bytes
• struct { handler_addr, string_addr, flag }
• German/Dutch localized strings

Key Handlers:
• VA 0x002C28D0 - Upgrade found (stages UI)
• VA 0x002C47F0 - No upgrade found (queue compact)
• VA 0x002C4524 - USB error (bubble errors)  
• VA 0x002C2048 - Update complete (queue maint)
• VA 0x002C3A94 - File open failed (wrapper)

=== SECURITY OBSERVATIONS ===

1. NO CHECKSUM/CRC VALIDATION
   • Validator @ VA 0x002BFDDC checks status bytes only
   • No hash verification in upgrade pipeline
   • Files trusted by filename match alone

2. USB MSC FULL R/W ACCESS  
   • Read/write to MINI volume (64MB)
   • FAT16 filesystem, standard operations
   • No encryption (About: "ENC:NO")

3. FREE SPACE AVAILABLE
   • ~3.0 GB free on internal storage
   • Safe for custom files/experiments

=== AUTOMATION BLOCKERS ===

Current workflow requires manual steps:
1. USB MSC activation needs touchscreen ("USB" menu)
2. File transfer only during USB mode
3. Device passive during USB mode (no operations)
4. No network interface (WiFi/Ethernet)
5. No USB serial protocol (just storage)
6. UART disabled (init → NOP loop)

For automation, requires firmware modification:
• Option A: Auto-activate USB MSC on cable detect
• Option B: Implement USB serial command protocol  
• Option C: Enable UART on GPB[2-5] debug pins
• Option D: Add network interface (hardware mod)

=== REMOTE CONTROL SOLUTION ===

Manual Workflow (Current):
1. Generate BMP from text (ImageMagick/PIL)
2. Connect printer → "USB" menu → mount MINI
3. Copy BMP to MINI volume
4. Disconnect
5. File → USB → Select BMP → Open → Start

Automated Workflow (Requires Firmware Patch):
1. Patch: Auto-activate USB MSC on cable connect
2. Script: Generate BMP → Connect → Transfer → Disconnect
3. Device: File ready → Physical button press → Print

OR

1. Patch: Implement USB serial protocol
2. Script: Send "PRINT_TEXT:Hello World" command
3. Device: Receive → Render → Print (no manual steps)

=== OPEN QUESTIONS ===

1. Which button/key triggers boot hold-key check?
2. What does "Start Signal" menu option do?
3. Is there external GPIO trigger for production line?
4. Where is CSV file (inkjet-lite-vadj-sample.csv) parsed?
5. Exact offsets of FAT filesystems on SD card?
6. Can device accept USB sticks? (Likely NO, confirmed NO)
summary: USB trigger mechanisms identified: (1) Boot-time hold-key detection calls maybe_update_from_udisk @ VA 0x0026887C. (2) Runtime menu via "OS Update"/"UI Update" menus. Device has USB DEVICE mode (MSC), NOT USB host. Exposes 64MB "MINI" volume (FAT16) when "USB" menu activated. User copies files to MINI via PC, then uses Update menus which COPY files from MINI (volume 0:/) to internal storage (volume 3:/) for processing. BMP printing via File → USB file browser: browse MINI volume, select BMP, Open in editor, adjust (zoom/rotate/mirror), press Start to print. No special filename pattern required. About screen shows 0.8/3.8GB used on internal storage, ~3GB free. No checksums - files trusted by filename match. Complete workflow documented for remote text-to-print via BMP conversion.
